{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOU4GkE88AAAABX20JmQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4BlaE0zhBa6Pg", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4BlaE0", "number": 34, "title": "Add account-free multiplayer bingo with one shared real-time session", "body": "## Context

Add a simple, account-free, real-time multiplayer bingo demo to `takahirox/sandbox`.

The repo already publishes static frontends on GitHub Pages and deploys a Cloudflare Worker with Durable Objects and WebSockets for shared, real-time games. Reuse that established pattern where sensible, keep Cloudflare Free usage modest, and do not introduce per-user registrations or separate room management.

## Goal

Build a web bingo game with **one global shared session (one room only)**. Many people can open the same URL and join. Every player has their own card, while a common stream of randomly drawn numbers is synchronized to all connected players in real time.

Use standard 75-ball bingo for this first demo: 5×5 cards with B/I/N/G/O columns using number ranges 1–15 / 16–30 / 31–45 / 46–60 / 61–75 and a free center square. The precise visual design is flexible, but keep the UI friendly and simple like other sandbox projects.

## User experience

### Joining

- [ ] Opening `projects/bingo/` goes directly into the **single shared bingo session**, not a room list.
- [ ] No account, login, email, player name, or invitation code is needed.
- [ ] Each participant gets their own randomly generated valid bingo card and keeps the same card when reloading/reconnecting during the same game.
- [ ] Show the card prominently, the most recently called number, and a compact history of numbers already drawn.
- [ ] People joining after the game has begun can see the current session/drawn numbers and participate with a consistent card/marking policy; document the chosen rule.

### Calling numbers

- [ ] Provide a simple **caller/host** role: one participant can claim the currently unclaimed caller role without registering.
- [ ] Only the active caller can start/restart the game or draw the next number. Other participants cannot trigger draws.
- [ ] Draw one uniform random number from the remaining 1–75 numbers per action; never draw the same number twice in one game.
- [ ] Push new draws instantly via WebSocket to all open browsers — **no polling**.
- [ ] Protect the caller role against hijacking: use a server-issued, unguessable role/reconnect credential, not a client-chosen ID or editable flag.
- [ ] On caller disconnect, allow a short rejoin grace period; then release the role so another participant can take over. Avoid a permanently stuck game.

### Marking cards and Bingo

- [ ] Make it obvious which card squares match drawn numbers. Allow tapping/clicking to mark a called number; never allow an undrawn number to count as marked. The center is FREE.
- [ ] Detect a completed horizontal, vertical, or diagonal line and show a joyful **BINGO!** celebration.
- [ ] Keep the server authoritative for the list of called numbers, player cards/marks, and verified bingo results (or validate an equivalent deterministic server-issued card representation). Do not trust arbitrary client-reported wins.
- [ ] Share confirmed Bingo events in real time without revealing private session/reconnect credentials.
- [ ] A Bingo does not need to force every other participant out immediately; define a simple, understandable session/end-of-game rule.
- [ ] The caller can reset for a fresh game with new cards and an empty draw history, using an explicit confirmation to prevent accidental resets.

## Interface

- [ ] Keep the page minimal and responsive: **Bingo card → latest number → previous numbers / status → necessary controls**.
- [ ] Use large, comfortable touch targets for card cells, suitable for phones and tablets as well as desktop.
- [ ] Display concise loading/disconnected/reconnecting states and recover without reloading if possible.
- [ ] Show the caller controls only for the caller; regular players should not see a clutter of host/admin controls.
- [ ] Use restrained animations/sound-free visual feedback for drawing and completing Bingo. Do not require audio or external assets.
- [ ] Support keyboard interaction, focus visibility, accessible result announcements, and reduced-motion preferences.

## Architecture / deployment

Prefer:

```text
GitHub Pages: projects/bingo/
        ↓ WebSocket
Existing Cloudflare Worker
        ↓
One named Bingo Durable Object
  ├─ single global session and caller role
  ├─ per-participant card/marks
  ├─ random draw history and Bingo checks
  ├─ persisted authoritative game state
  └─ live broadcasts
```

- [ ] Reuse the existing Cloudflare credentials, GitHub Actions deployment, and Workers setup where sensible rather than create another paid service.
- [ ] Persist necessary game/card/draw/role state using Durable Object storage so a restart or hibernation does not reset an active session.
- [ ] No D1 database is necessary unless there is a demonstrated reason for one.
- [ ] Protect the free-tier budget with sane per-client message/connection limits and server-side validation. Do not claim unlimited spectators/players beyond actual infrastructure limits.
- [ ] Integrate with the existing automatically generated sandbox gallery; adding `projects/bingo/index.html` should be sufficient for project discovery.
- [ ] Ensure local/screenshot builds can render the page safely without contacting the production backend, consuming production Cloudflare quotas, or writing production game state.
- [ ] Do not expose API tokens, caller credentials, or server-only secrets in public static files, logs, or public WebSocket messages.

## Validation

Add automated tests where practical, including:

- [ ] correct 75-ball card generation with free center and the proper column ranges
- [ ] uniform unique draws and correct exhaustion after 75 draws
- [ ] two or more simultaneous clients receiving the same draw history without polling
- [ ] distinct cards and stable reconnect/reload identity within one game
- [ ] caller-only drawing, caller reconnection, and caller relinquishment/timeout
- [ ] server rejection of invalid/out-of-order/duplicate messages and fraudulent marks/wins
- [ ] horizontal, vertical, and diagonal Bingo detection
- [ ] late join synchronization and session reset semantics
- [ ] state recovery after Durable Object reinitialization
- [ ] responsive frontend behavior and existing sandbox build/deploy regression checks

## Acceptance criteria

1. The bingo demo appears on the sandbox homepage and opens directly into a single shared session; **there are no room choices**.
2. At least several independent browsers/devices can join without registration and see their own 5×5 Bingo cards.
3. The caller draws a number, which appears for every connected player automatically and promptly via WebSocket.
4. A drawn number never repeats within the same game.
5. Users can mark only eligible called numbers and reliably receive a Bingo when they complete a line.
6. Refresh/reconnect retains the active game and appropriate player's card; unexpected server hibernation does not discard the game.
7. Unauthorized clients cannot draw/reset or forge Bingo results.
8. The existing Cloudflare Free-oriented automation and other sandbox demos keep working.

## Scope

This is the smallest useful **many-player, one-session bingo** demo. No registration, room creation, matchmaking, chat, payments, leaderboard, or complex host moderation.
